newsitem.title: UK: Burnfield adjourns EGM after revised bid.
newsitem.headline: Burnfield adjourns EGM after revised bid.

text.p: Shareholders of systems manufacturer Burnfield Plc adjourned an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) called on Monday to approve the acquisition of Ling Dynamic Systems and a rights issue.
The company said the EGM was adjourned after it received a revised bid offer from electronics and engineering manufacturer Fairey Plc on December 24.
Fairey has offered to 25 new shares for every 92 Burnfield shares, valuing Burnfield at 57.7 million stg.
Fairey had earlier put in a bid valuing Burnfield at 51.1 million stg, an offer the target firm rejected.
The adjourned extraordinary general meeting is scheduled to be held on January 23, Burnfield said in a statement.
